A1.definition: C = models x 2 sets x 1 look for the models of the row; level 1 - 0.05/C. One-model rows: C = 2 (97.5%). The prospective rows keep the level fixed in their protocols.

A3.note: approximate: normal approximation from the stored 95% intervals; the sign condition is not applied (no stored sign counts for most rows)

C.note: within limits with a true change above L is a wrong pass of this set; meets flag rule with a true change of 0 is a wrong flag of this set. The percentile bootstrap for each count uses 2,000 binomial draws (the same distribution as resampling requests).
